description: A seated flexibility hold that lengthens the posterior chain from hamstrings to the lower back.
setup: Sit upright on the floor with legs extended straight in front of you and toes pointing upward.
steps: Inhale and reach your spine tall through the crown of your head.
Hinge forward from your hips, leading with your chest toward your shins.
Rest your hands comfortably on your shins, ankles, or feet.
Breathe deeply into your belly and hold the gentle stretch.
cues: Hinge at the hips rather than rounding heavily through upper back
Exhale to relax deeper into the stretch with each breath

mistakes.mistake: Aggressively jerking forward to reach feet
mistakes.fix: Move smoothly into position and hold statically without bouncing

mistakes.mistake: Bending knees excessively off the floor
mistakes.fix: Keep legs straight with only a micro-bend if hamstrings are very tight

rep_standard: Timer runs while holding static forward fold position with legs extended and torso relaxed toward thighs.
